blind_statement: Authored from the frozen source + governed overlay + Standard v1.2 only. The Analytical Core was NOT run and no Core candidate/grouping/ranking/interpretation was inspected before this Gold was frozen. Author-independence caveat: the same programme author who built the 5R.9R repair authored this benchmark, so this is a process-blind (freeze-before-run) test, not an author-independent one; true independence needs a third-party author.
principles: Ordinal categories collapse only across adjacent positions of one polarity; a neutral 'mixed' midpoint is neither positive nor negative.
Distinct nominal reasons are distinct constructs; combining them is a cross-construct substitution.
Same-question same-construct percentages may be summed; cross-question percentages may be synthesised but never summed.
Aggregate distributions do not license respondent-level co-occurrence claims.
The largest single option is not automatically the story; a slim majority with a large dissenting minority is a fragile, not a strong, result.

forbidden_groupings.reason: 'Mixed / it depends' is the neutral midpoint, not reliability; relabelling the union as 'reliable' crosses the neutral boundary.
Opposite poles of one scale denote no coherent construct.
'Cheaper' and 'Convenient' are distinct governed reasons; relabelling as 'practical reasons' is a cross-construct substitution.
Cross-question percentages must never be summed.

must_find.concept: A slim majority find MetroLink reliable (positive region 56.8%), but only ~20% find it VERY reliable — reliability is adequate, not strong.
required_caveats: Only 20.5% say 'Very reliable'; the majority is soft.
Do not read a slim majority as strong reliability.
prohibited_extensions: Reporting only the largest single box (36% reliable).

must_find.concept: A substantial dissatisfied minority find it unreliable (negative region 24.4%) — a retention/quality risk.
Advocacy is split: 57.8% likely to recommend but a large 42.2% would not — reputational fragility.
prohibited_extensions: Claiming the recommenders are the reliability-satisfied respondents (respondent-level).

must_find.concept: No single dominant usage reason — cost (27.3%), no-car (23.9%) and speed (22.4%) are closely spread; cost leads by only 3.4pp, and much usage is necessity (no car), not preference.
prohibited_extensions: Merging reasons into a 'practical reasons' super-category.

may_find.concept: Reliability and recommendation are both slim-majority positive — a coherent 'adequate but fragile' story (aggregate synthesis, not respondent-level, no summed percentage).
A sizeable 'Mixed' reliability group (18.8%) sits on the fence.

must_not_say.prohibited_concept: 30% hold strong reliability opinions (very reliable + very unreliable).
Cost is the dominant reason for using MetroLink.
Reliability-satisfied commuters are the ones who recommend.
Combining reliability and recommendation into one percentage.

safety_critical: no forbidden ordinal grouping receives DERIVED authority
model-only novel quantitative interpretation cannot become Primary
alternative-explanation/construct-mismatch alone does not suppress a valid observation
recall: valid upper-threshold recodes (rel_top, rec_top) generated + DERIVED
valid lower-threshold recodes (rel_bottom, rec_bottom) generated + DERIVED
quality: Primary substantially matches the Gold central story (reliability positive region)
